title: St Ninian's Day Catholic Service
description: A Catholic service for St Ninian's Day will be held at Brampton Old Church. Time to be confirmed.

title: Council of Management Meeting
description: All members of the trust are welcome to attend.

description_parts.text: Join us for a Halloween afternoon at Brampton Old Church, featuring two Halloween-themed talks from local historians
, plus a spooky graveyard tour with local genealogist
focusing on some of the more gruesome stories around the church.
